runners_data.name: Antique Blue

races.paceDynamic: Torbados is the only confirmed front-runner in this 12-runner field and should get an uncontested lead on the rail, setting sustainable fractions without pressure from the prominent runners Space Moon. The majority of this field are hold-up horses including Popty Ping, Maximum Velocity, Thanos, and Mojito, creating a large pack that will need to find racing room in the straight. With one horse controlling the tempo and most runners needing to come from behind, this race strongly favours either the lone pace-setter or horses that can sit prominent and avoid the traffic that will inevitably develop among the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Torbados gets soft fractions and stays the trip effectively
scenarios.body: The gelded son gets an armchair ride on the rail and kicks clear when the hold-up horses are still organising behind him. His third at Lingfield in nursery company suggests he has the class edge when things fall right.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Space Moon can sit second and avoid the traffic problems
scenarios.body: The Ellison filly gets the perfect trip tracking the leader and has first run on the field when Torbados comes back to her in the final furlong. Her solid Leicester sixth suggests she's ready to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and the leaders come back dramatically
scenarios.body: Maximum Velocity gets the split he needs after his excellent Leicester second and powers through late with Popty Ping. The strong gallop plays to their closing kick style perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Torbados goes too fast early and multiple horses get competitive positions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with several horses in contention turning for home, favouring those with the best recent form. Thanos and Mojito benefit from the genuine pace.

watchPoints.text: Watch Torbados early - if he goes too fast trying to make all he could compromise his stamina reserves
Watch for traffic problems in the straight with so many hold-up horses needing racing room simultaneously
Watch Maximum Velocity's position turning in - needs splits to utilise his strong finishing kick
Watch Space Moon's jumping - needs to be handy early to avoid being caught behind the wall of hold-up horses
Watch the pace through the middle sections - if it's truly run it could set up a storming finish

races.paceDynamic: Hallandale Beach is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate a steady, sustainable pace from the gate. With no other natural leaders, he faces no early pressure and can control the tempo through measured fractions. The hold-up horses (Sanny Doo, Time To Take Off, Tickhill Flyer, Aurora's Doublesix) will be bunched behind, while the four newcomers add uncertainty to positioning. This controlled pace setup strongly favours the prominent and hold-up runners who can quicken late, as they'll get optimal race conditions behind an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Hallandale Beach maintains his recent improvement and gets soft fractions throughout
scenarios.body: His two recent novice efforts show promise and without pace pressure he can dictate ideal terms. The hold-up horses may struggle to close the gap if he finds another gear in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Time To Take Off reproduces her impressive Nottingham maiden win with tactical advantage
scenarios.body: She has proven class advantage over this field and James Doyle can position her perfectly behind the uncontested leader. Her strong finishing kick will be potent after controlled fractions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the well-bred newcomers shows natural ability first time out
scenarios.body: Manatee Mehmas or Lady Grey could exploit the tactical scenario with raw talent despite inexperience. The moderate pace will help them settle and their breeding suggests they belong at this level.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Hallandale Beach goes too slowly and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The fractions become so pedestrian that it turns into a sprint finish where any horse can win. This chaos particularly helps the 3lb-claiming apprentice on You Mystify Me in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Aurora's Doublesix has a pattern of fading in the final furlong despite being positioned to win - watch if blinkers solve this
Lady Grey and Manatee Mehmas are complete unknowns but any market confidence would be highly significant given their connections
Hallandale Beach gets an uncontested lead but has yet to convert promising efforts into victory - watch his response to pressure
Time To Take Off carries a 7lb penalty but James Doyle's presence suggests strong confidence in her class advantage
Watch the early positioning of the four newcomers as their running styles are unknown and could disrupt the expected tactical scenario

runners_data.name: Amora Queen

runners_data.name: Silky Lass
runners_data.note: Prominent type who broke maiden recently and benefits from lowest weight but lacks experience at this level

runners_data.name: Vilaine Verlaine
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 269-day absence with 5lb claiming jockey reducing competitive chances significantly
runners_data.comment: Dual 1m2f winner but off since coming in last at Sandown last July; others are preferred
runners_data.spotlight: A dual 1m2f winner at 2yrs but she's been off the track since coming in last of ten in 1m2f Sandown handicap last July; others are preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Dreamasar and Golden Muse will both want the lead from the off, with Dreamasar's natural front-running style clashing with Golden Muse's recent hat-trick seeking momentum. This early pace battle should create an honest gallop over the 1m2f trip, with the prominent racers Naga, Amora Queen, and Silky Lass tracking just behind the leaders. The sustained pace will set up the race perfectly for closers, as both front-runners may compromise each other early. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with finishing kicks over pure pace-setters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Clash
scenarios.trigger: If Dreamasar and Golden Muse engage in a pace duel from the start
scenarios.body: The early battle will drain both leaders, allowing the prominent runners tracking behind to inherit the initiative and kick clear in the final furlong. Naga's class and Amora Queen's tactical speed become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Golden Muse Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Muse can dictate terms uncontested on the front end
scenarios.body: Her hat-trick momentum and progressive profile allow her to control the gallop and find extra when challenged, with the light weight proving crucial. The lack of early pressure plays perfectly into Marco Botti's hands.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady early allowing closers to be competitive
scenarios.body: Vilaine Verlaine's hold-up style becomes a weapon despite the long absence, while prominent runners can time their challenges better. The 1m2f distance suits horses with a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Dreamasar Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Dreamasar can steal a march and avoid the early pace battle
scenarios.body: Ed Walker's filly uses her natural speed to establish a soft lead and kick again when challenged, with her class telling in the final stages. The long break proves beneficial rather than detrimental.

watchPoints.text: Golden Muse and Dreamasar could burn each other out if neither gives way in the opening two furlongs
Naga's fitness after 185 days off despite John Gosden's excellent record with returning horses
Vilaine Verlaine's market support will indicate connections' confidence after the long layoff
Amora Queen's ability to handle this step back up in grade after her Fillies' Mile failure
The pace early doors between the two confirmed leaders will determine the entire complexion of the finish

races.name: M&D Foundations Piling Specialists Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Sailor Song
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with improved recent form who will relish the expected strong pace and step up in trip
runners_data.comment: Cheekpieces now after Al Azd proved too strong late on Southwell (1m3f, AW); player
runners_data.spotlight: Made debut in February; improved when second in maidens at Doncaster (1m2f, good to soft) and Southwell (1m3f, AW; under Toby Moore) and now has cheekpieces after Al Azd proved too strong for him late on in the latest race; should be competitive on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Director's Cut
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from AW success but may struggle to sustain his pace against two other confirmed leaders
runners_data.comment: Fair 5th at Nottingham (1m2f, good) on return did not press his claims for handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Two runs in November were on AW, rallying to win a novice at Newcastle (1m) on second occasion; fair fifth of nine in a novice at Nottingham (1m2f, good) from the front on reappearance did not press his claims for today's handicap debut, but these are early days.

runners_data.name: Alba Gu Brath
runners_data.note: Natural pace-setter having his first turf start after 106 days off, which adds uncertainty to his fitness
runners_data.comment: Makes a striking move from 1m to 1m4f for this handicap/turf debut and needs a close look
runners_data.spotlight: Made debut in December; runner-up on first two starts before making all at 4-9 in a five-runner novice at Newcastle in January; all those races were 1m on AW and he kept hanging left last time, but he makes a striking move up to 1m4f for this handicap/turf debut and needs a close look.

runners_data.name: Lopeo
runners_data.note: Lead horse returning after 201 days off and recently gelded, making him unpredictable despite the strong pace setup
runners_data.comment: 1m win on heavy at Goodwood (three ran) last September, far better than starts either side
runners_data.spotlight: Showed staying potential with a 1m win on heavy ground in three-runner race at Goodwood last September, which was far better than his starts either side; gelded since; should be capable of better this season switched to handicapping but it is needed.

runners_data.name: Al Azd
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed improved stamina last time and carries top weight after recent Southwell victory
runners_data.comment: Looks quirky but beat Sailor Song in Southwell maiden (AW) when suited by move up to 1m3f
runners_data.spotlight: Looks quirky but he followed three seconds at 1m/1m2f by asserting late on from Sailor Song in a 1m3f maiden at Southwell (AW) two weeks ago, looking suited by the extra distance; blinkered on last two starts; 2025 turf form to start career was modest but another extra furlong should help; player.

runners_data.name: Stoneacre Donny
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning after 199 days who won from the back at Thirsk and suits this tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: Good third of seven off this mark at Nottingham (1m2f) in October; gelded since
runners_data.spotlight: 33-1 winner in an eight-runner novice at Thirsk (7f, soft) last September, coming from towards rear to lead in final strides; good third of seven in nursery at Nottingham (1m2f, good to soft; gelded since) in October made 1m4f looks plausible but he needs further improvement off the same mark.

runners_data.name: Shushi
runners_data.note: Prominent horse whose best form came on soft ground, potentially disadvantaged by the good to firm conditions
runners_data.comment: 1m3f AW maiden latest suggests she will stay 1m4f; needs to find extra on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Fair form on all three starts, best form on soft ground on second occasion; latest was her closest finish, though, when making most in a 1m3f maiden at Kempton (AW) and that performance suggests she will stay 1m4f; needs to find extra to get off the mark on this handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Three confirmed front-runners (Lopeo, Director's Cut, Alba Gu Brath) will create a fierce early gallop over this stamina-testing 1m4f trip. This strong pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves, particularly as all three pace-setters have questions over their ability to sustain such a gallop. The relentless early tempo will set up the race perfectly for hold-up horses like Sailor Song and Stoneacre Donny to pick up the pieces. This race shape strongly favours closers and late-running types who can capitalize on the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners engage in a speed duel from the start
scenarios.body: The fierce gallop will drain Lopeo, Director's Cut and Alba Gu Brath, allowing the hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong. Sailor Song and Stoneacre Donny are perfectly positioned to benefit from their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Survives Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Director's Cut or Alba Gu Brath can dictate without maximum pressure
scenarios.body: The winner breaks clear of the other pace-setters mid-race and has enough left to hold off the closers. Their superior fitness allows them to capitalize on an uncontested lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Al Azd or Shushi track the pace without getting involved early
scenarios.body: They avoid the early speed battle but stay close enough to pounce when the leaders weaken. Their tactical positioning proves decisive as they strike between the collapsing pace and emerging closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Holds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters cooperate and maintain a steady but not destructive tempo
scenarios.body: The front three work together early before one kicks clear, leaving insufficient time for the hold-up horses to close the gap. The strong gallop never reaches breaking point.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Director's Cut, Alba Gu Brath and Lopeo all commit to the early lead as this will create an unsustainable pace
Monitor Lopeo's behavior given his 201-day absence and recent gelding operation which could affect his racing temperament
Observe Al Azd's early positioning as he may hold the key from a prominent spot if the pace becomes too strong
Check how Stoneacre Donny travels given his long absence and whether Cam Hardie can get him into contention from the rear
Note the ground conditions as any ease in going would significantly boost Shushi's chances from her current outsider position

races.paceDynamic: The Cursor and Something are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop from the outset. With only two natural pace-setters in an 8-runner field, the tempo should be sustainable rather than destructive over this 1m4f trip. The prominent runners Sea Of Kings and Ghaiyya will track the leaders, while the hold-up horses Maghlaak, Charmaine, Machete and Kimeko Glory will get their preferred strong pace to aim at. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up horses who can benefit from the guaranteed strong gallop and finish strongly up the Doncaster straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the two front runners maintain honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will perfectly suit the closers who can unleash their finishing kicks. Maghlaak, Charmaine, Machete and Kimeko Glory all get their ideal scenario with a strong gallop to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Of Kings or Ghaiyya can track the pace without over-racing
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can stay close enough to the leaders while conserving energy for a decisive move. They avoid the risk of traffic problems that could hinder the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If The Cursor shows improved fitness after his 275-day break and gelding operation
scenarios.body: The son of Frankel has class on his side and could dictate terms if the pace becomes too honest for his own good. His July course and distance win shows he has the ability when right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners fail to go forward or tire early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with no genuine pace, suiting horses that can quicken from prominent positions. This would disadvantage the natural hold-up horses who need a strong gallop.

watchPoints.text: The Cursor is a non-runner which removes one of the key pace angles and reduces early speed

Maghlaak has been off for over seven months and switches from hurdles back to the flat
The going has firmed up to Good To Firm which may not suit all runners who prefer softer conditions

races.paceDynamic: Union Island and Pretty Spirited are the only horses with prominent/lead tendencies in this 13-runner field, creating a surprisingly weak pace scenario for a competitive handicap. With the majority holding up including Queen Of Good News, Pisanello, and Mariner, the early gallop will be modest and controlled. This sets up a sprint finish where late-running horses can get competitive positions turning for home. The lack of genuine pace pressure strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best turn of foot in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island and Pretty Spirited fail to inject genuine speed through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The field remains bunched turning for home creating a cavalry charge finish where the strongest stayers prevail. Hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks get ideal positioning to unleash their speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island maintains a strong gallop and Pretty Spirited tracks close throughout the race
scenarios.body: The pace becomes honest enough to stretch the field but not collapse the leaders completely. Horses racing handy get first run on the weakening hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is very slow and multiple hold-up horses get blocked for runs in the straight
scenarios.body: Traffic problems compound as late runners all arrive together seeking the same gaps. The horse with the clearest passage and best acceleration wins out.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Running Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island gets completely uncontested lead and Pretty Spirited sits second throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leaders to maintain their advantage despite the short straight. Late closers have too much ground to make up.
